batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c HH Pandya b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c HH Pandya b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c HH Pandya b J Suchith

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c LMP Simmons b MJ McClenaghan

batting.name: LMP Simmons
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b R Ashwin

batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b R Ashwin

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b DJ Bravo

balls.text: the innings ends with a run-out as Dhoni can't put a bat on this length ball, he takes off for a bye, but Parthiv hits the stumps to end Pawan Hans' innings
this one goes straight up, towards short third-man, but now McClenaghan drops it. This is a sitter. And what more, Dhoni has taken three from this
some swing this one! The batsman smashes it across the line and gets it very very high towards deep square leg. Suchith lines himself up, but drops it.. still manages to keep it in though
fires it in on the stumps, Dhoni digs it out to long on
this was a good delivery on Dhoni's body. The batsman gets into a tangle but gets some bat on it. Cruelly for the bowler, it runs away to the fine-leg boundary
full and on the leg stump line, no room for Negi, he squeezes it out to long on
he has just one plan - clear the front leg and punch it. This one is straight to long off
gets a low full toss wide outside off, looks to hammer it to the leg side but gets an inside edge on to his pads. He has been struggling with these full, wide ones for sometime now
full and wide, the batsman has to reach out as he digs it towards the right of cover for a single
that's a boxer's punch. This is a length delivery outside off and Negi slaps it over cover with some timing. One bounce and four
full and wide outside off, no room to get under, Dhoni punches it down to long off for a single
what timing! This isn't short enough but Dhoni just pulls it from a length, a lot of bottom hand on that, he clears deep square leg
he would have been run out had Simmons hit the non-striker's end. Dhoni clipped it straight to short fine leg but was a bit slow to take off
appeal from the bowler for a caught behind! No one else shows interest as Dhoni gets beaten by this slower one. Nothing on it
goes across the line and gets good amount of bat on that, drags it to the sweeper on the leg side
short delivery! This one gets big on him but he still manage to hack it to deep midwicket for a couple
whoaa! As Avnish says on feedback, Negi is the next Jadeja. He moves his front leg out of the way and hammers the fuller delivery over wide long on for a huge hit!
cramps the batsman for room from round the wicket line, the batsman pushes it to the off for a single
another powerful hit! This one is flatter, beats the diving cover fielder and races away through extra cover again
good connection this time! He makes room and throws his bat at the length delivery, gets good timing as he slaps it over cover
another pacy delivery! The batsman doesn't make contact. It just misses the stumps
not sure if he was planning to play it behind point, but he gets a boundary. Looking for cut, gets hurried by pace, but manages to steer over backward point
another sharp short ball, beats the batsman's pull
back of length, but this is down the leg side
this is the first one. Dhoni tucks this length delivery to midwicket for a single
gets more of a top edge on this shortish delivery, it lands safely at midwicket though. No timing there as he gets hurried by pace
back of length and aimed at Dhoni's chest. The batsman hops and defends it towards off, calls for a quick single
length ball on the pads, Negi gets off the mark with a whip to deep midwicket
fast length delivery on off stump, Negi can't get a bat on it

superb leaping catch by Simmons at short fine leg! Faf had moved across and he was always looking to flick it over the fielder, but doesn't get the timing. It lobs at slow pace, but Simmons still has to time his jump well. He falls backwards after taking the catch
he stays in the crease and guides this length delivery down to third man
digs out the fuller delivery towards deep cover for a single
bowls a full toss on the pads, that is eased to deep backward square leg
he makes room and looks to punch it through cover, but mistimes it back down the pitch
looks to drive this through extra cover but still no timing, gets it down to long on instead
this is more like it! Swings this down the ground, gets it to wide long-on without much timing
he looks to paddle this one from wide outside off, not a shot that Dhoni plays! Gets a bottom edge on to his pads
leans forward and punches this straight past the non-striker for a single. Not a good day for my fantasy captain
now Dhoni steps out and even though he doesn't get the whole lot behind it, it's enough to send it to the boundary. He dragged it from outside off to deep midiwicket
now sweeps this flighted delivery powerfully to deep square leg for a single
that wasn't really short but Faf uses the depth of the crease and smashes it over the cow corner for a six. Superb timing
slow and loopy, the batsman comes out of the crease but has to defend
slightly short and the batsman punches this off the back foot, into the open space at deep extra cover
length delivery outside off, steered down to third man
back of length on the stumps line, tucked away to square leg for a single
back of length and on off stump line, Faf shuffles across and works it away to deep midwicket
length delivery, but this is well wide of off, Dhoni cuts it down to third man for a single
length delivery on off, Dhoni punches it straight to mid-off
he looks to work this away to the leg side but gets beaten by the lack of pace, chips it almost to midwicket
he pushes this one to cover and calls for a quick single, makes it in just in time
much slower this time, Faf tucks it to square leg for an easy single
fires this one on the pads, the batsman whips it to deep midwicket for a single
no holding back this time. Dhoni comes down the pitch and throws a hammer as this one, smashes it over long on
straighter one, Faf stays back and nudges it to the right of point for a single
lots of air on this one. It turns as well, cramps the batsman for room as he defends off the back foot
fires this full on the stumps, Dhoni can only push it back at the bowler
comes out of the crease again, but is not to the pitch of it, defends it to off
comes down the pitch and defends the flatter delivery to midwicket
pushed through on stumps, worked away towards square leg for another single
goes deep in the crease and turns this one away behind square on the leg side for a single
nice bit of flight from Suchith, it's pushed to deep cover off the back foot
much slower. This one is loopy too. Dhoni nudges it to square leg again
pushes this through on the stumps line, Dhoni tucks it straight to square leg
gets some turn from outside off, the batsman works it away through square leg for a single
slower and tossed up on off. The batsman defends it off the back foot
stays deep in the crease and punches this flatter one to deep cover with ease

another one at deep midwicket, Pandya again! What are Super Kings upto today! Smith, after playing a strange innings, goes for the slog sweep and times it well. But this one is hit straight to the man at the boundary, who is standing right at the edge, takes an overhead chance easily
goes back and punches this one down the ground to long-on. Keeps strike as well
that almost squeezed through the gap between bat and pad! Smith gets some inside edge as he comes forward to defend

he has picked out Pandya! Raina came down the pitch, this time going squarer towards his favourite cow corner area, but he didn't get the distance. Pandya had to sprint to his right to get under it, he takes it easily, then keeps running all the way.
comes forward and pushes this tossed up delivery back to the bowler
super straight hit! He comes down the pitch and drives it over the umpire's head. Flat and very straight.
pushed through on the stumps, the batsman comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge towards square leg
pushed through on the stumps, Smith punches it down to long on for a single
gets a thick top-edge towards short fine leg but there is no one there. He was looking to pull but played it a bit too early
much slower this time. Gets some good bounce on this one, but Raina pushes it to deep cover off the back foot
stays back and defends the flatter delivery to midwicket
likes Harbhajan's pace! He goes down on his knee and reverse-paddles it fine to pick up a boundary
steps out of the crease and pushes this one through cover for a single to the deep
comes half-forward to a back of length delivery, gets an inside edge to the left of midwicket
fuller delivery, this time he manages to push it to long-on for a single
gentle short ball! Smith, a bit spooked after last over, decides to duck under it
still waiting on the back foot, he steers this length delivery to third man for a single
length delivery on off, Raina, who is staying back, defends it to off
short ball straightaway to Raina, but he hops and drags it towards long leg easily where McClenaghan makes a smart sliding save
superb over! This is a maiden. Smith has played out 12 dot balls from de Lange
dot ball no. 11 now.. Smith defends this one towards cover
that is pacy! Smith is now getting a bit fidgety.. throws his bat at that one and misses it completely
looks for a pull but gets beaten by the bounce
he still can't get any runs! Cuts this one by arching back, but hits it straight to backward point
he gets more respect from Smith. The batsman comes forward and defends it solidly towards cover
he gets into trouble first ball! Raina pushes this one to mid-off and comes down half the length of the pitch, but Smith hasn't moved. Raina makes it back just in time

he has picked the lone man at deep midwicket! It was only marginally short and McCullum probably thought he could clear the ropes, but he doesn't get the timing. Pandya walks in a few paces and takes an easy catch. A sigh of relief for Harbhajan

not entirely in control of this one, but this has been whipped to the boundary as well! He was always looking to hit this on the leg side, but gets it off the inside half. It runs away to the square leg boundary
now this one is more timing than power! Waits , opens the face and steers it to the left of point. It was in the air, but far away from the diving fielder
nothing wrong with that one! He arches back and smashes it over cover.. This was short and just over waist-high.. but that was never going to matter
plays an upper cut as soon as he sees it's slightly short! But that goes high than long.. lands safely behind backward point
tossed up and slower on off, the batsman defends it towards the vacant midwicket region and calls for a quick single
flatter and on the leg stump line, nudged to Harbhajan again
stays back and punches the length delivery to deep midwicket for a single
he comes forward and defends this back down the pitch
now Smith plays the same shot to the same ball but places it to the right of Harbhajan, gets four for it
dropped by Harbhajan! This was a long-hop alright but it was hit straight to Bhajji at backward square leg. Lets off McCullum. This was an easy chance
this is a good short ball! It's on the middle stump line and beats the batsman for pace. Smith went for a pull but made no connection
he waits on the back foot and steers the back of length delivery to Pollard
looks to thrash this shortish delivery, but gets a thick outside edge. There is no one at slip but it wouldn't have mattered. It was fairly high. Runs down to the boundary
this time he beats Pollard at point, and the third-man fielder! It wasn't the best of timing as he cut it late, but it was perfectly in the gap
hops on the crease and upper cuts it behind point. For a second the bowler is interested as he thinks it's going to travel all the way to third man.. but it drops short
he charges down the pitch and even though this is short and rising, that doesn't bother McCullum. He flat-bats it over long-on for a six
more solid defence! The batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover. Good first over from de Lange
back of length, the batsman defends it to the off side off the back foot this time
slightly slower and on target around off, Smith stays solid, defends it down the pitch
he comes forward and defends the 140 kph delivery down to the off side
fast, bouncy, it would have been hard to stop if Mohammad Irfan was keeping. Parthiv Patel is half the size.
this one zips past Smith's hips as he swivels for a pull but misses. The batsman looks towards the umpire but there is no call
back of length and pacy, the batsman punches it to cover point off the back foot
he plays just one way! Those fast hands come down hard on the length ball. But he has hit it straight back at the bowler, who boots it away to mid-on
stays back and steers the back of length delivery past Pollard and down to third man
cracks this rising delivery off the back foot, but it's straight to Pollard at poin
stays in the crease and defends the length delivery to off
digs in the bouncer straightaway, the batsman ducks under it
whoa what timing! He just pushes this back of length delivery to the off, then you see the extra cover diving and the mid-off chasing.. Rohit pulls it back
now Rayudu slogs, gets a top edge that runs down to the third-man boundary. But the last few minutes have all bee about Hardik. What a Pandya!!!
now even Jadeja has dropped a catch! Pandya goes for a slog, top edges this one towards deep midwicket, Jadeja walks in casually, but drops a sitter..
Negi has been hammered all over! Now Rayudu joins in in the fun and smashes it down the ground for the fourth six of the over.
fires a good yorker that the batsman is not able to get bat on, hits Dhoni's pads and rolls to the leg side
Pandyaaaaaa! This one is deep in the stands at long on! A huge huge hit. It was fuller.. it was smashed!
another six! This is a quicker one outside off, a length ball.. The batsman clears his front leg and hammers it hard over wide long-off. The fielder leaps up but can't reach it
looks to reverse paddle but this is wide outside off! Negi gets away with it as it's not called a wide
long handle! Pandya has long levers and he has thrashed this one over long. Tossed up, clean hit
fuller on the pads, Pandya flicks it through square leg for a single. Just four from the over
he comes down the pitch but gets a slower delivery, has to adjust and chop it to backward point for a single
superb yorker! This one comes in at his natural pace, swings in too and slides under the bat to the keeper
length delivery on the pads, Pandya gets off strike with a clip to deep backward square leg
slower one again, the batsman punches it to long on for a single

Raina won't make the mistake Faf made! Rohit is beaten by yet another slower delivery and yet again he manages to get height but not the distance. Raina settles under it at long on and takes it easily
he errs on the length and that is another free hit for Rayudu. The full toss is hammered over long on for the second six this over. Nehra ji has leaked again
superb yorker from Nehra! The batsman was making room, but has to dig it out to the off side
comes down the pitch and yorks himself, picks up a single towards cover though
fires a low full toss and Rayudu punches it over cover, where Baz leaps up and gets a hand to it, slows it down
length delivery, Rayudu gets his front leg out of the way and hammers it over long-on. Not a great connection but good enough.
fires it full from round the stumps, the batsman jams this one down to long on
another slower delivery, this time he calmly dabs it towards backward point for a single
dropped by Faf du Plessis, the South African! Rohit is beaten by the slower delivery as he looks to hit down the ground and that should have been an easy catch at long-off. What a clanger!
slower delivery outside off, Rayudu drags it to deep midwicket without any timing, just a single
fires this one full on the off stump line, the batsman squeezes it out towards deep point for a single
another slower delivery, but this is slightly full and Rayudu chips it to wide long off for a single
starts off with a slower delivery that is tucked to short fine leg by Rohit
slides the quicker one, this is pushed to extra cover for a single
fuller and on the stumps, the batsman digs it out to deep midwicket for a couple
comes forward and punches it through to long off
quicker delivery now, gets the outside edge and runs through point
much slower from Jadeja. Rayudu looks to pull and has to wait a long time before dragging it to the leg side
there is a hesitation as the batsman dabs this quicker delivery towards point, but they make it through comfortably in the end
steps out, but this one is slower again. Superb stuff from Negi. The batsman has to adjust and defend
quicker delivery on the stumps, punched back down the pitch again
slower again, the batsman pushes it back down the pitch
pushes at this flighted delivery and plays it too early! His bottom hand came off and the ball went in the air towards cover, safely in the gap though
tossed up on the stumps, the batsman leans into it and drives it to wide long off
slower and on the stumps, Rohit dabs it towards midwicket for a single
comes forward and punches this firmly to deep cover for a single
three men converging on a defended shot now! Dhoni, Raina and the man at cover
steps out of the crease and hits this one inside out to wide long-on where Faf covers ground and throws it back quickly to keep them to single
comes forward and pushes it through cover for another single
tossed up on the stumps, Rayudu gets off the mark with a single to long off
full and on the stumps, the batsman punches it to long off for a single

looked to punch this through off but gets a thick outside edge, that one flew past Raina at slip. He might have got a hand to that, he actually did. The two take off for a single, but hello hello, Bravo fires in a throw and catches Pollard short at the striker's end. Initially there wasn't much interest, but the replays show he is well out. What a bonus!
slower and loopy, Rohit defends it to the off side
flatter outside off, punched down to long on for a single
fuller and slower, the batsman pushes it towards mid-on but the bowler dives to his right to cut it off
comes out of the crease but gets a quicker one, ends up defending it down the pitch
pushed through on the stumps, Pollard comes forward and defends it to the leg side
good finish to the over. The batsman defends the tossed up delivery to off
tossed up outside off, the batsman nudges it towards midwicket but McCullum moves in swiftly to his right to prevent the single

make it two in the over! Now Simmons goes for a slog sweep by moving slightly inside the line, but he doesn't get the distance. This one is easily swallowed at deep midwicket by Smith. This is the wobble the home team were after
comes forward to the tossed up delivery, pushes it to cover
he leans into this flighted delivery, takes it on the full and pushes it to long on for a single

Faf has been taking some tremendous catches and he has another. This is a superbly-judged at the edge of the boundary at wide long-on. It was a flighted delivery, Parthiv got a lot of bat on it and made good connection in his slog sweep. But Faf gobbled it up.
fuller and faster from Jadeja, punched to long on for a single
looks to sweep again but misses this one
uses the sweep and uses it well! Drags it to deep square leg where there is no one manning the boundary
this just lands short of Faf at long off! Simmons made room and wanted to go inside out, but that went straighter. Luckily for him, he didn't get much timing on that
goes back and whips the flatter delivery over midwicket for a single to the deep
he goes back and punches it to wide long-off. Looked like a single from the offing but the batsmen decide for a second. A better throw from Bravo in the deep and Simmons would have gone
he lets this one go through as he sees it's wide, but that turns in to be just inside the safe zone
waits on the back foot and cuts this to short third man
slogs across line but doesn't get much timing, dragged to deep square leg for a single
fuller and quicker, pushed back down the pitch
looks to sweeps this one from the leg stump, but misses.. It turned and bounced over the leg stump. Saves it from being called a wide
tossed up outside off, Simmons comes forward to dab it in the gap at cover for a single
he is a little late to come forward on this quicker delivery, gets an inside edge through square leg
rocks back and cuts this quicker delivery to deep backward point
looks to sweep it from wide outside off but this one slides under the bat, that was not too far from off stump
goes back, lets the ball turn in and come to him, then plays it from in front of the stumps fine on the off side
full and flighted, punched back to the bowler
goes back and punches it in the air towards cover, Mohit dives forward but this slides under him and into the deep
follows it with full and fast one, the batsman squeezes it out through short third man. Enough pace provided by the bowler
that one keeps coming in with the arm! Simmons wanted to cut but was hit on the pad first, cramped for room.. Loud appeal, but the umpire doesn't think so. That was close
fired on the pads, the batsman misses and the bowler appeals, but that was always heading down the leg side
tossed up on the middle stump line, the batsman comes forward and punches it to long on
flatter and shorter on the stumps, Simmons rocks back and punches it to deep cover
fires it full on the stumps, the batsman digs it out towards cover
rocks back and cuts firmly but can't beat the man at backward point
he pushes this one towards cover point for a single
this was a mishit! No way it should have gone for a six. Simmons played too early, his bottom hand came off, and it looked as it wouldn't go beyond mid-off.. but it lands over the boundary. Crazy
pushed through wide outside off, the batsman looks to cut but is beaten by some extra bounce
slower, but this is short too. Parthiv rocks back and pulls it over midwicket. Not much power behind that though, Smith runs around from deep square leg and boots it in
fuller and on the stumps, the batsman punches it down to long on
fuller on the stumps, Simmons digs it out towards cover and takes off for a quick single. Had McCullum hit, Simmons would have been a gonner. The 50 comes up
keeps it tight on the stumps, the batsman defends it towards point
fires it full but Simmons walks to the off side and manages to flick it fine, another boundary. That wasn't a bad ball at all
back of length on the stumps, the batsman defends it to the off side
now finally! That gap at third man.. he has been eyeing it for a long time. Finally plays the late cut and finds the gap to the right of short third man
he takes a few tiny steps down the pitch, makes it a half-volley  and hammers it down the ground for a six at long on
the bowlers goes fuller, the batsman likes it there too. Parthiv takes the aerial route as he punches it over mid-on
fuller delivery on the stumps, Parthiv punches it on the up, straight to mid-off though
now whips this off the middle stump and picks up a couple to deep midwicket
fuller on off, Parthiv leans into this shot without really moving his feet forward, pings the gap at extra cover with precision
he has been looking for that gap behind point, but yet again, his cut is intercepted. This time, Jadeja dives to his right to cut it off
length delivery on off, the batsman pushes it to mid-off for a quick single
comes forward to drive, but gets a thick outside edge behind point
low full toss outside off, Simmons punches it through the infield, picks up a couple to deep extra cover
Pawan Hans can't cling on! This was a mistimed chip towards midwicket.. Negi dived forward, got to it, but dropped the catch
now he throws his bat at that this length delivery outside off, slices it with a lot of timing over point
short delivery, Parthiv was ready for that one, pulls that one powerfully behind square for a boundary
fuller and swings it away, Parthiv doesn't really come forward as he looks to drive, plays inside the line and is duly beaten
looks for that gap behind point again but finds Jadeja this time.
good bit of timing  as Parthiv punches this fuller one to mid-off, takes off for another quick single
chops this one to the right of backward point for a quick single. There is no third man.. and Simmons was looking for that gap but Brendon dove to his right to stop that one
now he uses the slight room to cut this behind point for a single to the deep
superb timing! He  stands on his toes and punches this length delivery, exactly the same shot he played last ball but this time he hits it in the gap.. it races away
stands tall and punches this length delivery on the up, but hits it straight to cover
stretches forward and defends the fuller delivery to off
tossed up wide outside off, the batsman covers the line of stumps and lets it go through
fires this one in, but loses direction. Down the leg side, this one
cramps the batsman for room with the angle, but Parthiv manages to push it to long on
he goes back and punches firmly a flatter delivery, can't beat the man at cover
tossed up wide outside off, the batsman leans into it and pushes it to mid-off for a quick single
flatter delivery on off, the batsman defends it down the pitch
